description: Plan 032 Faz 032g — kernel-owned MCP server registry. A spawn loads ONLY the servers its runtime profile names (`mcp_servers`), always under --strict-mcp-config, so the repository's .mcp.json never reaches an autonomous agent. env_passthrough carries NAMES; secret-shaped names are refused at load time.

aria.description: Read-only view of the ARIA store (status, missions, findings, pressures, governance, handoffs, daily report, search, delivery, progress). Write tools are excluded for agents; operators run the server with --allow-writes.
